name: Wrath++ native
description: What Wrath++'s interface can't do in the stock 32-bit client by itself: the character creator's current choice and option count for each customization (WrathPP_GetCustomization), a choice put in directly (WrathPP_SetCustomization), whose character is being made (WrathPP_GetCreating), that character with or without its starting outfit (WrathPP_SetGear), and the creator's own lines in the runtime's log (WrathPP_Log).
